label: Updated at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: LIV Team Championship Cancelled
items.text: LIV Golf is on the verge of canceling its August Team Championship in Michigan due to withdrawal of Saudi funding, possibly making the Bedminster event the season penultimate stop.

items.headline: Koepka Withdraws from Rocket Classic
items.text: Brooks Koepka withdrew from the Rocket Classic for personal reasons, leaving him 84th in FedExCup points and needing a strong finish at Wyndham to reach playoffs and retain 2027 Signature Event eligibility.

items.headline: Rocket Classic Ends After This Year
items.text: Rocket Companies is ending sponsorship of the Rocket Classic, making this the tournament's final year; the PGA Tour will replace it with the new Sompo Championship in Napa for 2027.
